_about: Hand-kept notes for the Cosmos tab: who owns each facet, its stage, the next step, and the work log. Numbers are not kept here; scripts/tool-surface.mjs recomputes them from the cosmos registry and sweep. Seeded 2026-10-11 from the Cosmos Cube Board artifact.
now: The rails, before the shelves. What 1110 to 1114 built that a game can ask for is counted as values since the second pass (a game that starts in play behind a cutscene, the turn every level session runs, the opening on a world map, the obstacle course and a level that rolls, the goblin and the orc and a kin's bands, the pursuer, the game's colour, a backdrop); the rails are not values and are still not counted: the playthrough, a world's arsenal and its one scale, the casting call, the rooms, the seeds audit, one HUD host a level page and the touch pad on mana-ui. Where the rails stop is the work: the sentence door reads an action genre, lays its camera and casts its foes, and writes no arsenal, so no level's hero plays strings and no level is played (the `action` door probe holds it at 'not'); and five gates each ask whether a level can be won (the walk, the playthrough, the work proof, the seeds audit, the course's reaction bot) and share no verdict.
next: In order, each a join and none a shelf row: the sentence door lays the kit its feel names and gives the action RPG its feel without the word that names a template, and the cast is cast again when the kit changes; one won-gate, the five players behind one verdict in the made record and the bible, a rolled level played by the playthrough over its seeds; the turn as the one session path (the arena shell and versus still keep their own set-up) with a world's set-up reaching the arsenal and the difficulty the playthrough plays; a made room as a level (the game room and the work shift laid in the book, exported, drawn in the bible); the level keys that carry a room's condition (skandart, wet, daylight); the rest of play on mana-ui (talk, the quest log, a world that says no `ui`); sound from a gameworld, as a channel every level reads. Four of these joins are priced values the sweep ranks (space.levelForm=room, the condition package, game-ui, sound); beside them, made and with no word in a designed game: the lorecube in play, a level's library, the finished frame.

reality.name: Reality
reality.next: Gen-7 is priced (the era large, the cast large and needing the era); the cast rig lights every body under the land's one sun. Sound from a designed gameworld is still the widest recipe: the SFX shelf is read by the rooms, never by a level by word, and a world has no sound key. A level's HUD rows, its pause button and its touch pad are mana-ui's on a world that says `ui`, on one host a level page; talk, the quest log and a world with no `ui` are the interface gap left, now a medium one. Debris, wetness, daylight and the ashlar crypt reach a world recipe and no key of a designed game's level: that join is priced now (the condition package, a room's state of repair in one word). The game's colour is counted: the cast solved clear of its ground, the land taken in a direction. The finished frame (bloom, the sky in a specular face) is a level recipe's key and a form page's default; exposure that adapts and water under it are open.

space.name: Space
space.next: The written map, its zones and the megaworld are built; a level rolls (a seed picks its cover, pickups, start and a paced line of obstacles) and a sample of its seeds is walked and played. Open still waits on a border crossed anywhere and a page streamed. The headset is partial. The game room is the practice door's alone (levelForm=room, local, priced): a made room laid in the book is the join. The obstacle course is a level form of its own (levels.<id>.obstacles), and a world map opens on its opening (the controls as lessons, then an enemy trail). Stylish action's cube asks for rooms and the door lays trail walks. A phone's pad is the HUD's; its size and place wait on a real phone.

power.name: Power
power.next: Strings (a world's arsenal, its foes numbered on the kit's scale) and the work mechanic (a shift from the quick door) are built, and a fight level is played by a scripted player. The sentence door writes no arsenal, so a game from a sentence is unarmed and unplayed until the readout's step is taken; only fights are played (no gun level, shift or course). The throw is the brawler's alone and the storeys-high leap is in parts: comic-blows. The practice door opens the firing and artillery ranges from a gameworld, and no level carries a turret: the brawler and the crewed machines wait on a gameworld's door. The lorecube's parts (what opposes what, a reserve, who holds a share, a monster manual, a skill tree) are made and checked and no gameworld takes one: one large package, named for the join (orders from lore): the film's order is the first working case of one studio handing another a structured order.

soul.name: Soul
soul.next: The mascot pilots; a stored animal or creature still does not. A sentence's hero is designed as a person of its world and coloured against its land with its foes. The crewed machines are driven only in the artillery range. A flight's body is still a slab. The seat settings are as they were: a work shift is one cook's. The peoples a foe is skinned as are read live from the foe shelf, the goblin and the orc dated; a kin's foes are wild, adorned or a pack.

mind.name: Mind
mind.next: The pursuer joins the foe classes, and a people's foes carry their lineage's arms; the casting call reads the hero's kit, once, when the world is composed: a kit written after it casts nothing again. Found and open in the runtime: a mind's ground snap is cast from its head (a boss climbs out of the blade's reach), and the brute's blow that cannot be blocked is blocked. The agent commander is the one priced gap.

time.name: Time
time.next: A game can start in play, and a level step is a turn: a world's set-up asked before every level, the load, play, the pause, the results, a scene or a video at its start and end (the arena shell and versus keep their own; an end trigger that is a scene and a quit recorded are not yet). The cutscene's video is not carried into the export. Held cinematics, replay in play, keying, quest turns and side quests by the main quest are the priced gaps. The cutscene, the start in play and the turn are values now (sequence). A cutscene can be a film the animation studio made to the game's order, carried into the export (sequence: film); the order is filled in by hand, so a story moment filmed by its name is the priced gap (moment-film). A gameworld keeps its backdrop; a level's library of books is a level recipe's key with no word in a designed gameworld: priced.

log.text: A second pass over the same merges (1110 to 1114), for the capabilities the first left in the notes. Counted as built and dated: the cutscene step, a game that starts in play and the turn (time.sequence), the opening on a world map and a fight that comes after another, the obstacle course as a level form, the goblin and the orc among the peoples a foe is skinned as (read live from the foe shelf), a kin's foes wild, adorned or a pack, the game's colour (the cast solved clear of its ground, the quiet land and the colour script), a gameworld's backdrop. Priced, each made and with no word in a designed game: the lorecube's parts (large), a room's condition (the board's join, now a package), a level's library, the game room as a level, the finished frame (medium each). No probe changed its verdict. The totals fell, and nothing broke: 43 of 500 random worlds makeable (was 69), 288 near the probes (was 294), because the map now names those gaps and a rolled world that asks for one reads short; 42 of the 43 are made by the fortnight's values. Exhibits, galleries and the kiosk have nothing to win and stay off the cube; the trucks and launchers are shelf rows. Through 1113-animation-studio-infra: the animation studio's outcome is a film, so it stays off the cube too; its join is counted (time.sequence=film, a cutscene made to the game's order and played from its flow) and its open half priced (moment-film).

The cube caught up with the merges through 1114 (lorecube to the game turn). New and dated: a level that rolls (space.levelDesign=roll), the ashlar crypt's kit, the pursuer. The level HUD on mana-ui is part built (a level's rows, the pause button, the touch pad, on a world that says ui), so its package is the rest (talk, the quest log) and medium. The notes name the practice door's ranges and rooms, the start in play, the turn and a world's set-up. Nothing waiting on a gameworld's door moved (the brawler, the crewed machines, sound), and the totals did not: 69 of 500 random worlds makeable, 294 near the probes. That is the finding: the fortnight built rails the cube does not count (the playthrough, the arsenal's scale, the seeds audit, the turn, the HUD host); the trucks and launchers of 1114 are shelf rows and no value. The action games get a door probe, held at 'not': a sentence lays the camera and the cast and no arsenal, so its hero plays no strings and the playthrough plays no level. The co-op kitchen asks for the work mechanic. Now and next say the joins in order.

The cube caught up with November’s merges (through 1109-geocube-sharpening). Marked built: knockback, the destruction degrees and destructible physics, triggered breaks, the vayo moves, the guard and parry, the feel card, the written map, the course, the world map’s zones and the megaworld’s rings, the scenario and the play layer, the screen a game is made for, the mascot, the body kinds, the front and the shell on mana-ui, the grade and the juice, a moment that takes the camera. Priced: gen-7, sound from a gameworld, the level HUD on mana-ui, the headset. Four probes (a 3D platformer, an action RPG, a destruction sandbox, a headset adventure): three makeable. Values now say the day they were built, and the page counts what the last fortnight’s made: 66 of 72 makeable random worlds, 120 of 302 near the probes.

Battle city, phases 1 to 7 (1025-battle-city): one contest kernel (match, meet, turns) with the ball card, the hit and the minds; the meet, the court, the course and the pitch on the World page; the quick goals meet and contest; a sport written out from a distilled rulebook. The four sport values read built; the hero body on the pitch and the engines’ kernels are the gaps left.

Battle city priced (1025-battle-city): sports as a contest over the movement stack. Four probes (an athletics meet, a net game, a turn sport, a team goal game) and the values they wait on: the meet and contest mechanics, a court level form, a team, a positional motivation, one package. The ball already exists (physics-sim's sphere with spin and restitution, flight.js's real air); the contest kernel does not.

MX11 (a795157c): animals live in packs and herds. Wolves fan out and ring their prey, two biting at a time; herds graze together and scatter as one. Plus 3aeb28bd: rules now read the world clock (memory, regrowth and shared sight were reading 0).

MX10 (7cc8c56e): groups. N minds share a target, sight and spacing; traversal patterns (column, line, wedge, fan-out, encircle, pincer, close, scatter) chain into plans; attack tokens let K press in at once.
Operator played the Mind demo: 'it works … every creature reacted differently.' MX9 (f8163b2d): predators hunt with a natural bite that lunges; prey flee any hunter.
MX8 landed (2a30c94c): idle minds wander, graze food, escort a ward, and warn intruders before attacking. Every Mind motivation now resolves built. Makeable 46 → 61, blocked 269 → 215 of 500.
MX7 landed (59d0ee7c): minds can be limited to what they see (range, facing cone, line of sight), and remember where they last saw you: they go there, search, then give up.

MX5 landed (b560dcbe): minds find their way round walls. A* over a walk grid baked from the colliders; a hunter stuck behind a wall now walks out and round. Blocked games 297 → 269 of 500. Next context: competition and racing (plan drafted).

MX6 landed (3434b88e): bosses cross health phases (bolder under 2/3, relentless and closing to the blade under 1/3, with a short invincible beat) and adapt by benching the fighting mode that lost the trade. Minibosses adapt when asked.

MX4 landed (99af1dc6): the arena's commander is an engine module. A body marked rule.commanded is driven at strategy rate by the built-in commander, a page hook or an HTTP endpoint. The arena's 29 behaviour tests moved beside the engine. Kite and the built-in commander are built; makeable 40 → 45 of 500. The mobile-suit branch leaves the merge plan.

MX3 landed (9c150c0c): a guard engages only near its post and walks back to it; prey flees inside its fear radius. Animals' minds run on the engine. The top-down adventure is now blocked only by its camera.
MX2b landed (a2671ff1): the suit maneuvers became engine verbs. The mobile-suit pack tracks nothing; the arena is fully absorbed and its traces are byte-identical.
MX2 landed (76bd23d0): ms-ai.js retired. Per-character tuning over the class tier; passive and defensive temperaments. Makeable games 11 → 40 of 500; the arena brawler is fully makeable.

The arena's ai rule moved into the engine as the mind. All four controllable traces byte-identical, the three arena bouts included; 13 page pins re-pinned after proving only the embedded engine source changed.
MX1 landed (a380c626): the mind matrix, a generated table for every named mind and species, and the Mind facet on the new axes. A miniboss rotates; a boss also shifts at health phases and adapts.
Moved to my own worktree and branch, 1010-mind-matrix, from 9c2c1e50; the other session keeps 1010-cosmos-sweep.
Paused: another session is editing the 1010-cosmos-sweep worktree (Time facet, fixtures, and core sweep files). MX1 parked outside it; nothing of theirs touched.
MX1: the arena's easy, medium and max tiers equal novice×wary, regular×bold and ace×opportunist exactly. Deer flee from their prey tag; wolves cannot hunt yet (no animal holds an attack verb).
Skill is a base for a class of minds, tuned per character. Duelling is a rank: minibosses and bosses hold a repertoire and switch through it.

Mind becomes a matrix like fauna behavior: motivation × actions × capability × aggressiveness. The arena is absorbed as a preset and then retired. Fauna tags (predator, prey) give every species a mind for free.
Committed S1–S2 (9c2c1e50). From here each step commits when its machine gates pass; nothing is pushed.
S1–S2: every gap carries an effort and a work package; the sweep ranks packages by lifts per unit of work. The general mind leads.
First person already plays (a heroless walker); the registry said absent. Corrected to partial.
Sized the gaps with three read-only sweeps: Mind's lift is moderate extraction under existing traces; pathfinding needs the walk grid shipped to the page; turn-based combat is the largest build.
Split the work: a separate agent takes 7th-gen scaling (Reality's rungs); Claude takes the cosmos structure and the gaps in Space, Power, Soul and Mind.
This board went live.
Rebased onto 1d797412 (the 3.1.0 fold). test:critical fully green.
Sweep draw density set to 0.2 and ranking by lifts, so the map says something.
P3–P4: fixtures, the seeded sweep, the unlock ranking and the CLI.
Mind exists only inside the mobile-suit arena: recorded as local, a mine to lift.
Time goes to its own branch, built by you with another agent; time.js ships as an honest stub.
P0–P2: the facet schema, a generated capability registry, depth and the dry run (ea1f464c).
Named the cosmos cube and its six facets; the Reality facet is the geocube.
